class _ControlFlowBlockExtractor:
    def __init__(self, root: Path, rel_path: str, source: str) -> None:
        self.root = root
        self.rel_path = rel_path.replace("\\", "/")
        self.source = source
        self.anchors: dict[str, Anchor] = {}
        self._counter = 0

    def extract(self) -> dict[str, Anchor]:
        tree = ast.parse(self.source)
        for node in tree.body:
            if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
                self._walk_statements(node.body, self._function_id(node.name))
            elif isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
                for child in node.body:
                    if isinstance(child, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
                        symbol = "{}.{}".format(node.name, child.name)
                        self._walk_statements(child.body, self._function_id(symbol))
        return self.anchors

    def _function_id(self, symbol: str) -> str:
        return "{}::{}".format(self.rel_path, symbol)

    def _block_id(self, owner_id: str, kind: str, lineno: int) -> tuple[str, str]:
        self._counter += 1
        suffix = "{}:{}:{}".format(kind, lineno, self._counter)
        block_id = "{}#{}".format(owner_id, suffix)
        symbol = "{}_block_{}".format(kind, self._counter)
        return block_id, symbol

    def _block_hash(self, owner_id: str, kind: str, node: ast.AST, extra: str = "") -> str:
        raw = "{}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}".format(
            owner_id,
            kind,
            getattr(node, "lineno", 0),
            _line_end(node),
            extra,
            self.rel_path,
        )
        return hashlib.md5(raw.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12]

    def _create_block_anchor(
        self,
        owner_id: str,
        kind: str,
        node: ast.AST,
        symbol: str,
        block_id: str,
        block_metadata: dict[str, Any],
        scope_label: str | None = None,
    ) -> Anchor:
        return Anchor(
            id=block_id,
            symbol=symbol,
            file=self.rel_path,
            line_start=int(getattr(node, "lineno", 0) or 0),
            line_end=_line_end(node),
            hash=self._block_hash(owner_id, kind, node, str(block_metadata)),
            language="python",
            symbol_type="virtual_block",
            is_virtual=True,
            virtual_kind=kind,
            parent_anchor=owner_id,
            scope_label=scope_label,
            block_metadata=block_metadata,
        )

    def _append_calls(
        self,
        anchor: Anchor,
        calls: Iterable[tuple[str, int]],
        scope_label: str,
        seq: int,
        condition: str | None = None,
    ) -> int:
        """将调用列表追加到 anchor.callees，返回下一个可用 seq。"""
        for name, lineno in calls:
            anchor.callees.append({
                "target": name,
                "scope_label": scope_label,
                "condition": condition,
                "is_conditional": bool(condition),
                "seq": seq,
                "line": lineno,
            })
            seq += 1
        return seq

    def _append_child(
        self,
        anchor: Anchor,
        child_id: str,
        scope_label: str,
        seq: int,
        condition: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        anchor.callees.append({
            "target": child_id,
            "scope_label": scope_label,
            "condition": condition,
            "is_conditional": bool(condition),
            "seq": seq,
        })

    def _process_branch(
        self,
        body: list[ast.stmt],
        block: Anchor,
        block_id: str,
        scope_label: str,
        condition: str | None,
        seq_start: int,
    ) -> int:
        """按语句顺序处理分支 body，直接调用和子虚拟块交错分配 seq，返回下一个可用 seq。"""
        seq = seq_start
        for stmt in body:
            item_seq = seq
            if isinstance(stmt, ast.If):
                before = set(self.anchors)
                seq = self._handle_if(stmt, block_id, seq)
                for child_id in set(self.anchors) - before:
                    if self.anchors[child_id].parent_anchor == block_id:
                        self._append_child(block, child_id, scope_label, item_seq, condition)
            elif isinstance(stmt, (ast.For, ast.AsyncFor, ast.While)):
                before = set(self.anchors)
                seq = self._handle_loop(stmt, block_id, seq)
                for child_id in set(self.anchors) - before:
                    if self.anchors[child_id].parent_anchor == block_id:
                        self._append_child(block, child_id, scope_label, item_seq, condition)
            elif isinstance(stmt, ast.Try):
                before = set(self.anchors)
                seq = self._handle_try(stmt, block_id, seq)
                for child_id in set(self.anchors) - before:
                    if self.anchors[child_id].parent_anchor == block_id:
                        self._append_child(block, child_id, scope_label, item_seq, condition)
            else:
                calls = _collect_stmt_calls(stmt)
                seq = self._append_calls(block, calls, scope_label, seq, condition)
        return seq

    def _walk_statements(self, statements: list[ast.stmt], owner_id: str, seq_start: int = 0) -> int:
        seq = seq_start
        for stmt in statements:
            if isinstance(stmt, ast.If):
                seq = self._handle_if(stmt, owner_id, seq)
            elif isinstance(stmt, (ast.For, ast.AsyncFor, ast.While)):
                seq = self._handle_loop(stmt, owner_id, seq)
            elif isinstance(stmt, ast.Try):
                seq = self._handle_try(stmt, owner_id, seq)
        return seq

    def _handle_if(self, node: ast.If, owner_id: str, seq_start: int = 0) -> int:
        block_id, symbol = self._block_id(owner_id, "cond", int(getattr(node, "lineno", 0) or 0))

        cases: list[tuple[str, str, list[ast.stmt]]] = []
        current = node
        cases.append(("case:0", _source_text(self.source, current.test), current.body))
        idx = 1
        default_body: list[ast.stmt] = []
        while current.orelse:
            if len(current.orelse) == 1 and isinstance(current.orelse[0], ast.If):
                current = current.orelse[0]
                cases.append(("case:{}".format(idx), _source_text(self.source, current.test), current.body))
                idx += 1
            else:
                default_body = current.orelse
                break

        block = self._create_block_anchor(
            owner_id,
            "condition",
            node,
            symbol,
            block_id,
            {
                "cases": [
                    {"scope_label": label, "condition": cond}
                    for label, cond, _ in cases
                ],
                "has_default": bool(default_body),
            },
        )

        # 所有分支并列从 seq_start 开始，各自顺延，取最大值
        max_seq = seq_start
        for label, condition, body in cases:
            branch_end = self._process_branch(body, block, block_id, label, condition, seq_start)
            max_seq = max(max_seq, branch_end)

        if default_body:
            branch_end = self._process_branch(default_body, block, block_id, "default", None, seq_start)
            max_seq = max(max_seq, branch_end)

        self.anchors[block_id] = block
        return max_seq

    def _handle_loop(self, node: ast.AST, owner_id: str, seq_start: int = 0) -> int:
        block_id, symbol = self._block_id(owner_id, "loop", int(getattr(node, "lineno", 0) or 0))
        if isinstance(node, ast.While):
            expr = _source_text(self.source, node.test)
            loop_kind = "while"
        else:
            expr = "{} in {}".format(
                _source_text(self.source, node.target),
                _source_text(self.source, node.iter),
            )
            loop_kind = "for"

        block = self._create_block_anchor(
            owner_id,
            "loop",
            node,
            symbol,
            block_id,
            {"loop_kind": loop_kind, "expr": expr},
        )

        # body 先顺序排，orelse 接 body 末尾（loop 不 break 才执行）
        body_end = self._process_branch(node.body, block, block_id, "body", None, seq_start)

        if getattr(node, "orelse", None):
            orelse_end = self._process_branch(node.orelse, block, block_id, "orelse", None, body_end)
            final_seq = orelse_end
        else:
            final_seq = body_end

        self.anchors[block_id] = block
        return final_seq

    def _handle_try(self, node: ast.Try, owner_id: str, seq_start: int = 0) -> int:
        block_id, symbol = self._block_id(owner_id, "try", int(getattr(node, "lineno", 0) or 0))
        metadata: dict[str, Any] = {
            "handlers": [],
            "has_else": bool(node.orelse),
            "has_finally": bool(node.finalbody),
        }
        block = self._create_block_anchor(owner_id, "try", node, symbol, block_id, metadata)

        # body 先执行
        body_end = self._process_branch(node.body, block, block_id, "body", None, seq_start)

        # handlers 和 orelse 并列（互斥：有异常走 handler，无异常走 orelse）
        max_handler_seq = body_end
        for idx, handler in enumerate(node.handlers):
            scope_label = "case:{}".format(idx)
            exc_name = _source_text(self.source, handler.type) if handler.type else "Exception"
            block.block_metadata["handlers"].append({"scope_label": scope_label, "exception": exc_name})
            handler_end = self._process_branch(handler.body, block, block_id, scope_label, exc_name, body_end)
            max_handler_seq = max(max_handler_seq, handler_end)

        if node.orelse:
            orelse_end = self._process_branch(node.orelse, block, block_id, "else", None, body_end)
            max_handler_seq = max(max_handler_seq, orelse_end)

        # finally 一定执行，排在所有分支之后
        if node.finalbody:
            finally_end = self._process_branch(node.finalbody, block, block_id, "finally", None, max_handler_seq)
            final_seq = finally_end
        else:
            final_seq = max_handler_seq

        self.anchors[block_id] = block
        return final_seq

def _block_hash(self, owner_id: str, kind: str, node: ast.AST, extra: str = "") -> str:
        raw = "{}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}".format(
            owner_id,
            kind,
            getattr(node, "lineno", 0),

def _append_calls(
        self,
        anchor: Anchor,
        calls: Iterable[tuple[str, int]],
        scope_label: str,
        seq: int,
        condition: str | None = None,
    ) -> int:
        """将调用列表追加到 anchor.callees，返回下一个可用 seq。"""
        for name, lineno in calls:
            anchor.callees.append({
                "target": name,
                "scope_label": scope_label,
                "condition": condition,
                "is_conditional": bool(condition),
                "seq": seq,
                "line": lineno,
            })
            seq += 1
        return seq

def _resolve_import_attribute(target: str, raw_callee: dict, anchors: dict,
                              caller_file: str | None) -> Optional[str]:
    """Resolve ``module_alias.func()`` when the alias comes from an import."""
    ref = raw_callee.get("import_ref")
    if not isinstance(ref, dict) or not caller_file:
        return None

    module = str(ref.get("module") or "")
    imported = str(ref.get("imported") or "")
    level = int(ref.get("level") or 0)
    module_parts = [part for part in module.split(".") if part]
    imported_parts = [part for part in imported.split(".") if part]
    if level:
        package_parts = caller_file.replace("\\", "/").split("/")[:-1]
        ascend = max(level - 1, 0)
        if ascend > len(package_parts):
            return None
        base = package_parts[:len(package_parts) - ascend] if ascend else package_parts
        module_parts = base + module_parts
    module_parts += imported_parts
    if not module_parts:
        return None

    module_path = "/".join(module_parts)
    suffixes = (
        "{}.py::{}".format(module_path, target),
        "{}/__init__.py::{}".format(module_path, target),
    )
    matches = [
        anchor_id
        for anchor_id in anchors
        if any(anchor_id.replace("\\", "/").endswith(suffix) for suffix in suffixes)
    ]
    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

def _resolve_js_module_call(target: str, raw_callee: dict, anchors: dict,
                            caller_file: str | None, root=None) -> Optional[str]:
    """Resolve a require/import alias to the anchor it names.

    A relative specifier was always handled. A bare one — `pkg/deep/path`, which
    is what a package's own parts use to reach each other — was answered with
    "packages remain external", so a project organised into modules produced no
    cross-file edges at all and said nothing about it. Now the specifier goes to
    the resolver, which answers only from what the project itself declared:
    package.json exports, tsconfig paths, a workspace sibling's name.
    """
    ref = raw_callee.get("module_ref")
    if not isinstance(ref, dict) or not caller_file:
        return None
    module = str(ref.get("module") or "")
    if not module:
        return None
    imported = str(ref.get("imported") or "")
    symbol = target if imported in {"", "*", "default"} else imported
    files = []
    if root is not None:
        try:
            from parse.codeAnalysis.analyzer.js_resolver import resolver_for
            files = resolver_for(str(root)).candidates(module, caller_file.replace("\\", "/"))
        except Exception:
            files = []
    if not files:
        if not module.startswith("."):
            return None
        base = posixpath.dirname(caller_file.replace("\\", "/"))
        raw_path = posixpath.normpath(posixpath.join(base, module))
        suffix = posixpath.splitext(raw_path)[1]
        files = [raw_path] if suffix else [
            raw_path + ext for ext in (".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".jsx", ".mjs", ".cjs")
        ]
        if not suffix:
            files += [posixpath.join(raw_path, "index" + ext)
                      for ext in (".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".jsx", ".mjs", ".cjs")]
    matches = []
    for file_name in files:
        exact = "{}::{}".format(file_name, symbol)
        if exact in anchors:
            matches.append(exact)
        matches.extend(
            anchor.id for anchor in anchors.values()
            if anchor.file.replace("\\", "/") == file_name
            and str(anchor.symbol or "").rsplit(".", 1)[-1] == symbol
            and anchor.id != exact
        )
    matches = list(dict.fromkeys(matches))
    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

def _resolve_js_factory_member(target: str, raw_callee: dict, anchors: dict,
                               caller_file: str | None,
                               caller_anchor=None) -> Optional[str]:
    """Resolve `value.member()` when value came from `createThing()`."""
    factory = str(raw_callee.get("factory_ref") or "")
    if not factory or not caller_file:
        return None
    file_name = caller_file.replace("\\", "/")
    prefixes = []
    symbol = str(getattr(caller_anchor, "symbol", "") or "")
    owner = symbol.rsplit(".", 1)[0] if "." in symbol else ""
    while owner:
        prefixes.append(owner + "." + factory)
        owner = owner.rsplit(".", 1)[0] if "." in owner else ""
    prefixes.append(factory)
    for prefix in prefixes:
        candidate = "{}::{}.{}".format(file_name, prefix, target)
        if candidate in anchors:
            return candidate
    return None

def _finalize_anchor_graph(anchors: dict, *, only_ids: "set[str] | None" = None,
                           root=None) -> None:
    """Re-resolve callees/call_sites for every anchor, or only a scoped subset.

    ``only_ids`` (used by the incremental update path) restricts the
    expensive resolve pass to: anchors from the just-rescanned files
    themselves, anchors elsewhere that call into an id that was added,
    changed, or removed by this update, and anchors carrying a call site
    that never resolved in an earlier pass (so it gets retried in case the
    target now exists). Everything else keeps whatever it already has —
    correct, since a full pass already resolved it and nothing that would
    change its answer has moved. A full rebuild passes ``None`` and always
    resolves everything, which stays correct by construction (see below).
    """
    unique_symbol_ids = _build_unique_symbol_ids(anchors)
    unique_leaf_ids, leaf_candidates = _build_leaf_symbol_ids(anchors)
    ambiguous_names: set[str] = set()
    registry_templates: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    unique_class_ids = _build_unique_class_ids(anchors)

    def resolve_ids(resolution_ref, anchor) -> list[str]:
        if isinstance(resolution_ref, dict) and resolution_ref.get("call_kind") == "registry_template":
            template = str(resolution_ref.get("registry_template") or "")
            # A template of nothing but wildcards matches every key there is.
            # `**` compiled to `^.+.+$`, so an ordinary `sd.update(...)` was
            # read as a call to the entire registry — and then the entire
            # registry was copied into that one call site. A pattern that
            # cannot exclude anything is not evidence; it is the absence of it.
            if template.replace("*", "").strip() == "":
                return []
            pattern = "^{}$".format(_re.escape(template).replace(r"\*", ".+"))
            receiver_names = {
                str(resolution_ref.get("receiver") or ""),
                str(resolution_ref.get("registry_name") or ""),
            } - {""}
            exact = []
            matched = 0
            counted = set()
            taken = set()
            for candidate in anchors.values():
                for entry in _registration_entries(candidate):
                    if not _re.match(pattern, entry["key"]):
                        continue
                    pair = (entry["key"], candidate.id)
                    if pair not in counted:
                        counted.add(pair)
                        matched += 1
                    # One registration yields two entries: one carrying the
                    # decorator that made it and one without. Deduplicating on
                    # (key, id) alone let the nameless entry win the slot, so
                    # the receiver check below never saw the name and every
                    # template resolved to nothing.
                    if entry["name"] in receiver_names and pair not in taken:
                        taken.add(pair)
                        exact.append(pair)
            # No receiver match means the target is unknown. Answering with
            # every key that fit the pattern says "all of them", which is a
            # different claim and a false one — and it is the claim that made
            # one anchor record grow past a hundred megabytes.
            if not exact:
                resolution_ref["registry_matched"] = matched
                return []
            resolution_ref["_registry_matches"] = exact
            registry_templates[template] = sorted({aid for _, aid in exact})
            return [anchor_id for _, anchor_id in exact]
        direct = _resolve_call_id(
            resolution_ref,
            anchors,
            unique_symbol_ids,
            unique_leaf_ids,
            caller_file=anchor.file,
            caller_anchor=anchor,
            root=root,
        )
        if direct:
            return [direct]
        if not isinstance(resolution_ref, dict) or resolution_ref.get("call_kind") != "attribute":
            return []
        method_name = str(resolution_ref.get("target") or "")
        resolved = []
        for class_name in resolution_ref.get("receiver_types", []) or []:
            class_id = unique_class_ids.get(str(class_name))
            class_anchor = anchors.get(class_id) if class_id else None
            method_id = (
                getattr(class_anchor, "effective_methods", {}).get(method_name)
                if class_anchor else None
            )
            if method_id in anchors and method_id not in resolved:
                resolved.append(method_id)
        return resolved

    scope = anchors.values() if only_ids is None else (
        anchors[aid] for aid in only_ids if aid in anchors
    )
    for anchor in scope:
        normalized_callees = []
        normalized_sites = []
        sites = list(getattr(anchor, "call_sites", []) or [])
        # call_sites carry occurrence-level evidence and may legitimately be
        # longer than the de-duplicated `callees` summary. Pairing the two by
        # list index shifted every target after the first repeated call.
        refs = sites if sites else list(anchor.callees)
        for idx, raw_callee in enumerate(refs):
            if isinstance(raw_callee, dict):
                site = dict(raw_callee)
                resolution_ref = site
            else:
                site = {}
                resolution_ref = raw_callee
            target_ids = resolve_ids(resolution_ref, anchor)
            if not target_ids:
                # Keep the call rather than dropping it: its target is still
                # unresolved (e.g. a registry key with no matching decorator
                # yet), not gone. call_sites and callees stay index-aligned
                # (a placeholder goes in both) so a later pass over this same
                # anchor can retry using the original site data — and
                # because an unresolved target never contains "::", the fast
                # accept-path above never mistakes it for already resolved.
                kept_site = dict(site)
                kept_site.setdefault("seq", idx)
                kept_site.setdefault("line", 0)
                kept_site.setdefault("conds", ["nocond"])
                raw_target = str(kept_site.get("raw_target") or kept_site.get("target") or raw_callee)
                # A receiver call such as ``ctx.get()`` is not evidence that
                # the only project function named ``get`` is its target.  In
                # particular this used to connect production code to test
                # doubles. Candidate hints are useful only for unresolved
                # bare-name calls.
                is_attribute = kept_site.get("call_kind") == "attribute"
                leaf_name = raw_target.replace("::", ".").rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
                candidates = [] if is_attribute else leaf_candidates.get(leaf_name, [])
                kept_site["resolution"] = "possible" if len(candidates) > 1 else "unresolved"
                if candidates:
                    # The candidate set belongs to the NAME, not to the call
                    # site. Copying it into every site multiplied one list by
                    # every place the name is called: with a few thousand
                    # same-named symbols (a venv full of torch and numpy will
                    # do it) and a hundred call sites, one anchor record grew
                    # past a hundred megabytes. The set is written once, beside
                    # the anchors, and a site points at it.
                    kept_site["candidates"] = leaf_name
                    kept_site["candidate_count"] = len(candidates)
                    ambiguous_names.add(leaf_name)
                normalized_sites.append(kept_site)
                kept_target = kept_site.get("target") or raw_callee
                if kept_target not in normalized_callees:
                    normalized_callees.append(kept_target)
                continue
            for target_id in target_ids:
                resolved_site = dict(site)
                resolved_site["target"] = target_id
                resolved_site.setdefault("raw_target", _call_target(resolution_ref))
                resolved_site["resolution"] = "exact"
                resolved_site.setdefault("evidence", "canonical-id" if "::" in str(_call_target(resolution_ref)) else "unique-symbol")
                registry_matches = (
                    resolution_ref.get("_registry_matches", [])
                    if isinstance(resolution_ref, dict) else []
                )
                for key, candidate_id in registry_matches:
                    if candidate_id == target_id:
                        resolved_site["registry_key"] = key
                        break
                # The pair list is how this site found its key; it is not part
                # of the answer. Left in, it was copied into every site of every
                # caller of a registry — one record reached 534.8KB from 87
                # copies of the same 7,392-byte list, and one index reached
                # 68.6GB. The key above is what a reader needs.
                resolved_site.pop("_registry_matches", None)
                resolved_site.setdefault("seq", idx)
                resolved_site.setdefault("line", 0)
                resolved_site.setdefault("conds", ["nocond"])
                if target_id not in normalized_callees:
                    normalized_callees.append(target_id)
                normalized_sites.append(resolved_site)
        if anchor.symbol_type == "class":
            constructor_id = getattr(anchor, "effective_methods", {}).get("__init__")
            if constructor_id in anchors and constructor_id not in normalized_callees:
                normalized_callees.append(constructor_id)
                normalized_sites.append({
                    "target": constructor_id,
                    "seq": len(normalized_sites),
                    "line": anchor.line_start,
                    "conds": ["nocond"],
                    "call_kind": "constructor",
                })
        anchor.callees = normalized_callees
        anchor.call_sites = normalized_sites

    # Handed to the writer so the shared table lands next to the anchors.
    _finalize_anchor_graph.last_ambiguous = {
        "names": {name: list(leaf_candidates.get(name, [])) for name in sorted(ambiguous_names)},
        "registry": {k: registry_templates[k] for k in sorted(registry_templates)},
    }

    for anchor in anchors.values():
        anchor.callers = []
    for anchor in anchors.values():
        if anchor.is_virtual:
            continue
        for raw_callee in anchor.callees:
            target_id = _call_target(raw_callee)
            target = anchors.get(target_id)
            if not target:
                continue
            if anchor.id not in target.callers:
                target.callers.append(anchor.id)

def _module_anchor_for_file(root: Path, file_path: Path) -> Optional[Anchor]:
    try:
        source = file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        tree = ast.parse(source)
    except Exception:
        return None
    call_sites = _extract_module_call_sites(tree)
    if not call_sites:
        return None
    rel = _normalize_file_ref(root, file_path)
    anchor_id = "{}::<module>".format(rel)
    return Anchor(
        id=anchor_id,
        symbol="<module>",
        file=rel,
        line_start=1,
        line_end=max(1, len(source.splitlines())),
        hash="",
        language="python",
        symbol_type="module",
        callees=[site["target"] for site in call_sites],
        call_sites=call_sites,
        block_metadata={"module_entry": True},
    )

def search_anchors(keyword: str, root=".", file_prefix: str = None,
                   symbol_type: str = None, top_n: int = None) -> List[Anchor]:
    """
    模糊搜索锚点，返回匹配列表。

    参数：
        keyword     — 在 symbol 名中做子串匹配（空字符串 = 不过滤）
        root        — 目标项目路径
        file_prefix — 只返回该文件路径前缀下的锚点，如 "api" / "src/trainer"
        symbol_type — 只返回指定类型："function" / "method" / "class"
        top_n       — 最多返回 N 条
    """
    anchors = load_anchors(root)
    results = []
    for a in anchors.values():
        if keyword and keyword not in a.symbol:
            continue
        if file_prefix and not a.file.startswith(file_prefix):
            continue
        if symbol_type and a.symbol_type != symbol_type:
            continue
        results.append(a)
        if top_n and len(results) >= top_n:
            break
    return results

def visit_Subscript(self, node: ast.Subscript) -> None:
        template, config_paths = _fstring_template(node.slice)
        if template:
            receiver = self._expr(node.value)
            site = {
                "target": template,
                "seq": self.seq,
                "line": int(getattr(node, "lineno", 0) or 0),
                "conds": list(self.conds) if self.conds else ["nocond"],
                "call_kind": "registry_template",
                "receiver": receiver,
                "registry_reference": True,
                "registry_template": template,
            }
            if config_paths:
                site["config_paths"] = config_paths
            import_ref = self.import_aliases.get(receiver)
            if import_ref:
                site["registry_name"] = str(import_ref.get("imported") or "")
            self.call_sites.append(site)
            self.seq += 1
            self.visit(node.value)
            for value in getattr(node.slice, "values", []):
                if isinstance(value, ast.FormattedValue):
                    self.visit(value.value)
            return
        self.generic_visit(node)

def _merge_code_anchor(anchors: dict, ca, root: Path) -> None:
    try:
        rel = str(Path(ca.file).relative_to(root)).replace("\\", "/")
    except ValueError:
        rel = _normalize_file_ref(root, ca.file)

    symbol_info = _code_anchor_symbol(ca)
    if symbol_info is None:
        return
    symbol, sym_type = symbol_info

    lang_map = {"py": "python", "cpp": "cpp"}
    lang = lang_map.get(ca.language, ca.language)

    key = "{}::{}".format(rel, symbol)
    decorators = ca.metadata.get("decorators", [])
    dec_meta = _normalize_registration_decorators(decorators, symbol)
    anchors[key] = Anchor(
        id=key,
        symbol=symbol,
        file=rel,
        line_start=ca.line_start,
        line_end=ca.line_end,
        hash=ca.hash,
        callers=ca.metadata.get("callers", []),
        language=lang,
        symbol_type=sym_type,
        registered_as=_extract_registered_as(dec_meta),
        block_metadata={"decorators": dec_meta} if dec_meta else {},
    )

def _merge_parsed_anchor(anchors: dict, parsed) -> None:
    """Merge one language-adapter record without weakening a richer anchor."""
    existing = anchors.get(parsed.id)
    if existing is None:
        anchors[parsed.id] = Anchor(
            id=parsed.id,
            symbol=parsed.symbol,
            file=parsed.file,
            line_start=parsed.line_start,
            line_end=parsed.line_end,
            hash=parsed.hash,
            language=parsed.language,
            symbol_type=parsed.symbol_type,
            qualified_name=parsed.symbol,
            signature=parsed.signature,
            imports=list(parsed.imports),
            parent_anchor=parsed.parent_anchor,
            callees=list(parsed.callees),
            call_sites=[dict(site) for site in parsed.call_sites],
        )
        return
    if parsed.line_end > existing.line_end:
        existing.line_end = parsed.line_end
    if not existing.parent_anchor and parsed.parent_anchor:
        existing.parent_anchor = parsed.parent_anchor
    if not existing.qualified_name:
        existing.qualified_name = parsed.symbol
    if not existing.signature:
        existing.signature = parsed.signature
    if not existing.imports:
        existing.imports = list(parsed.imports)
    # Analyzer call sites are useful even when codeGenome supplied the anchor.
    if parsed.call_sites and not existing.call_sites:
        existing.call_sites = [dict(site) for site in parsed.call_sites]
        existing.callees = list(parsed.callees)

def _write_anchors(root: Path, anchors: dict) -> None:
    output_path = root / ".codedendrite" / "anchors.json"
    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    data = {k: _anchor_to_storage(v) for k, v in anchors.items()}
    with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    # One file for every ambiguous name, instead of one copy per call site.
    # A site carries the name; this is what the name means. Kept beside the
    # anchors rather than inside them so nothing that walks anchors.json as a
    # flat map of anchors has to learn about a new top-level key.
    table = getattr(_finalize_anchor_graph, "last_ambiguous", None)
    if isinstance(table, dict):
        with open(output_path.parent / "candidates.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(table, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

def resolve_multi_level_inheritance(
    index: CppClassIndex,
    class_name: str,
    max_depth: int = 20
) -> List[Dict]:
    """
    解析多层继承链

    参数：
        index: 类索引
        class_name: 类名
        max_depth: 最大深度

    返回：
        继承链列表，每个元素包含类信息和深度
    """
    result = []
    visited = {}
    depth = 0

    def resolve(name: str, current_depth: int):
        if current_depth >= max_depth or name in visited:
            return

        visited[name] = current_depth

        cls = index.get(name)
        if cls:
            result.append({
                "name": cls.name,
                "file": cls.file,
                "line": cls.line,
                "bases": cls.bases,
                "depth": current_depth,
                "is_template": cls.is_template,
                "is_struct": cls.is_struct
            })

            for base in cls.bases:
                base_name = base.split('::')[-1]
                resolve(base_name, current_depth + 1)

                for full_name, full_cls in index.classes.items():
                    if full_name.split('::')[-1] == base_name and full_name not in visited:
                        resolve(full_name, current_depth + 1)
        else:
            result.append({
                "name": name,
                "file": "[forward_declaration]",
                "line": 0,
                "bases": [],
                "depth": current_depth,
                "is_template": False,
                "is_struct": False
            })

    resolve(class_name, 0)
    return result

def find_subclasses(index: CppClassIndex, class_name: str) -> List[CppClassInfo]:
    """
    查找类的所有子类（包括多层继承的子类）

    参数：
        index: 类索引
        class_name: 类名

    返回：
        子类列表
    """
    subclasses = []
    class_short_name = class_name.split('::')[-1]
    visited = set()

    def search(name: str):
        for cls in index.values():
            if id(cls) in visited:
                continue

            for base in cls.bases:
                base_short_name = base.split('::')[-1]
                if base_short_name == class_short_name or base == name:
                    visited.add(id(cls))
                    subclasses.append(cls)
                    search(cls.name)

    search(class_name)
    return subclasses

def find_template_instantiations(
    index: CppClassIndex,
    template_name: str
) -> List[CppClassInfo]:
    """
    查找模板类的实例化

    参数：
        index: 类索引
        template_name: 模板名

    返回：
        实例化列表
    """
    instantiations = []

    for cls in index.values():
        if cls.templates and cls.is_template:
            if cls.name.startswith(template_name):
                instantiations.append(cls)

    return instantiations

def search_symbol(symbol: str, root: str = ".", language: str = None, search_type: str = "definition"):
    """
    搜索符号定义或引用。

    参数:
        symbol: 要搜索的符号名（函数名、类名）
        root: 项目根目录
        language: 编程语言（可选，自动检测）
        search_type: "definition"（默认）或 "references"

    返回:
        匹配结果列表，每个元素包含:
        {
            "name": str,        # 符号名
            "file": str,        # 文件路径
            "line": int,        # 行号
            "type": str,        # "function" | "method" | "class"
            "class_name": str,  # 所属类名（方法时有值）
            "parameters": list, # 参数列表
        }
    """
    analyzer = get_analyzer(root, language=language)
    project_info = analyzer.analyze()

    matches = []
    for func in project_info.functions:
        if search_type == "definition":
            if func.name == symbol or (func.class_name and f"{func.class_name}.{func.name}" == symbol):
                matches.append({
                    "name": func.name,
                    "file": func.file_path,
                    "line": func.line_number,
                    "type": "method" if func.is_method else "function",
                    "class_name": func.class_name,
                    "parameters": func.parameters,
                })
        elif search_type == "references":
            # 搜索调用此符号的位置
            for other_func in project_info.functions:
                if symbol in other_func.calls:
                    matches.append({
                        "name": other_func.name,
                        "file": other_func.file_path,
                        "line": other_func.line_number,
                        "type": "caller",
                        "class_name": other_func.class_name,
                        "content": f"{other_func.name} 调用了 {symbol}",
                    })

    return matches

def main(argv=None) -> int:
    args = list(argv or sys.argv[1:])
    if len(args) != 4:
        print("usage: yaml_profile_worker ROOT MODULE FUNCTION YAML", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    root, module_name, function_name, yaml_path = args
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(root).resolve()))
    top_package = module_name.split(".", 1)[0]
    loaded_top = sys.modules.get(top_package)
    if loaded_top is not None and not hasattr(loaded_top, "__path__"):
        del sys.modules[top_package]

    captured = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(captured):
        module = importlib.import_module(module_name)
        loader = module
        for part in function_name.split("."):
            loader = getattr(loader, part)
        result = loader(Path(yaml_path))
    if hasattr(result, "to_dict"):
        result = result.to_dict()
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        raise TypeError("{} returned {}, expected mapping".format(
            function_name, type(result).__name__,
        ))
    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
    return 0

def _insert_logs_in_file(file_path: str, funcs: list[dict]) -> int:
    """
    funcs: [{symbol, line}]，line 是索引行号提示（1-based，允许偏移）。
    用 _find_def_line 定位真实 def 行，从底往上插避免行号偏移。返回插入数。
    """

    try:
        lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").splitlines(keepends=True)
    except Exception as e:
        print("  SKIP {}: {}".format(file_path, e))
        return 0

    resolved = []
    for func in funcs:
        hint = func.get("line") or 1
        real_line = _find_def_line(lines, func["symbol"], hint)
        if real_line is None:
            print("  WARN: def not found for {}".format(func["symbol"]))
            continue
        resolved.append({"symbol": func["symbol"], "line": real_line})

    resolved.sort(key=lambda f: f["line"], reverse=True)
    count = 0
    for func in resolved:
        def_idx = func["line"] - 1
        indent_idx = def_idx
        while indent_idx > 0 and not lines[indent_idx].lstrip().startswith(("def ", "async def ")):
            indent_idx -= 1
        indent = _indent_of(lines[indent_idx])
        log = '{}print("[AUTOLOG] {}")  {}\n'.format(indent, func["symbol"], MARKER)
        lines.insert(def_idx + 1, log)
        count += 1

    path.write_text("".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    return count

def cmd_add_file(file_rel: str, target: str) -> None:
    """给单个文件内所有真实函数/方法插 log，不依赖 chain。"""
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent.parent))
    from serve.api.inspector import list_file_anchors

    funcs = list_file_anchors(file_rel, target)
    if not funcs:
        print("No anchors found in: {}".format(file_rel))
        return

    abs_path = file_rel if Path(file_rel).is_absolute() else str(Path(target) / file_rel)
    funcs_for_insert = [{"symbol": f["symbol"], "line": f["line"]} for f in funcs]

    print("File anchors ({} functions):".format(len(funcs)))
    for f in funcs:
        print("  line={} {} [{}]".format(f["line"], f["symbol"], f["type"]))

    n = _insert_logs_in_file(abs_path, funcs_for_insert)
    print("\n+{} logs -> {}".format(n, abs_path))
    print("Remove: python -m tools.CodeDendrite.api.autolog remove {}".format(target))

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="autolog",
        description="自动插入/撤销调试 log（基于 CodeDendrite 链路）",
    )
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="cmd")

    p_add = sub.add_parser("add", help="沿链路插入 log")
    p_add.add_argument("symbol", help="入口函数名")
    p_add.add_argument("target", help="项目根目录（已有 .codedendrite/）")
    p_add.add_argument("--depth", type=int, default=6, help="追链深度（默认 6）")
    p_add.add_argument(
        "--direction", choices=["down", "up", "both"], default="down",
        help="追链方向：down=追 callees，up=追 callers，both=双向（默认 down）",
    )

    p_af = sub.add_parser("add-file", help="给整个文件所有函数插 log（不走 chain）")
    p_af.add_argument("file", help="相对路径，如 shared/provider/service.py")
    p_af.add_argument("target", help="项目根目录")

    p_afd = sub.add_parser("add-folder", help="给整个文件夹所有 .py 所有函数插 log（chain 断时用）")
    p_afd.add_argument("folder", help="相对路径，如 shared/provider")
    p_afd.add_argument("target", help="项目根目录")

    p_rm = sub.add_parser("remove", help="撤销所有 autolog")
    p_rm.add_argument("target", help="项目根目录")

    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.cmd == "add":
        cmd_add(args.symbol, args.target, args.depth, args.direction)
    elif args.cmd == "add-file":
        cmd_add_file(args.file, args.target)
    elif args.cmd == "add-folder":
        cmd_add_folder(args.folder, args.target)
    elif args.cmd == "remove":
        cmd_remove(args.target)
    else:
        parser.print_help()

def run(task_book_path: str, call_llm: Callable[[str, List[dict]], str]) -> dict:
    """
    执行整个任务本。

    Args:
        task_book_path: JSON 文件路径
        call_llm: fn(system_prompt, messages) → str

    Returns:
        {"outputs": {task_id: result_str}, "diffs": [str, ...]}
    """
    tasks = json.loads(Path(task_book_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    outputs: Dict[str, str] = {}
    diffs: List[str] = []

    first_project = tasks[0]["project"]
    cd_root = str(Path(__file__).parent.parent)
    indexed: set = set()

    def _ensure_indexed(proj: str) -> None:
        if proj in indexed:
            return
        print(f"[cd_init] {proj}")
        r = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "api/cli.py", proj, "--update"],
            cwd=cd_root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180
        )
        print(r.stdout[-500:] or r.stderr[-200:])
        indexed.add(proj)

    _ensure_indexed(first_project)

    for task in tasks:
        tid = str(task["task_id"])
        project = task.get("project", first_project)
        print(f"\n{'='*50}\n[Task {tid}] {task.get('task', task.get('entry', ''))}")

        _ensure_indexed(project)

        # ── 注入前序输出 ──
        def inject(s: str) -> str:
            for k, v in outputs.items():
                s = s.replace(f"{{{k}}}", v)
            return s

        # ── 普通任务（info + task 字段）──
        if "task" in task and "entry" not in task:
            info_str = _expand_info(task.get("info", []), project)
            user_msg = f"{info_str}\n\n---\n{inject(task['task'])}"
            system = "你是项目分析 agent，简洁回答，不要废话。"
            msgs = [{"role": "user", "content": user_msg}]
            result = call_llm(system, msgs)
            print(f"[output] {result[:200]}")
            if "output_as" in task:
                outputs[task["output_as"]] = result.strip()
            continue

        # ── 导航任务（entry + error 字段）──
        context = inject(task.get("system_context", outputs.get("brief", "该项目")))
        system = _NAV_SYSTEM.format(context=context)
        state = {"chain": None}
        first_msg = _nav_first_msg(task, context)
        msgs: List[dict] = [{"role": "user", "content": first_msg}]

        collected_diff = []
        collecting = False
        consecutive_errors = 0

        for _ in range(20):  # 最多 20 跳
            try:
                response = call_llm(system, msgs)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"  [llm_error] {e}")
                outputs[tid] = f"[FAILED] llm error: {e}"
                break

            msgs.append({"role": "assistant", "content": response})
            print(f"  [model] {response[:120]}")

            cmd, arg = _parse_cmd(response)

            if collecting:
                if cmd == "任务完成":
                    diff_text = "\n".join(collected_diff)
                    diffs.append(diff_text)
                    outputs[tid] = diff_text
                    print(f"  [diff collected] {len(diff_text)} chars")
                    break
                collected_diff.append(response)
                continue

            if cmd == "输出diff":
                collecting = True
                msgs.append({"role": "user", "content": "请输出 diff，完成后输出 <任务完成>"})
                consecutive_errors = 0
                continue

            if cmd == "任务完成" or cmd is None:
                if cmd is None:
                    consecutive_errors += 1
                    if consecutive_errors >= 3:
                        print(f"  [abort] 连续 3 轮无有效命令，任务终止")
                        outputs[tid] = "[FAILED] no valid command"
                        break
                    msgs.append({"role": "user", "content": "请输出一个有效命令，或 <任务完成> 结束。" + _NAV_APPEND})
                    continue
                break

            # 执行工具
            tool_result = _run_tool(cmd, arg, project, state)
            print(f"  [tool:{cmd}] {tool_result[:100]}")
            consecutive_errors = 0
            msgs.append({"role": "user", "content": tool_result + _NAV_APPEND})

    return {"outputs": outputs, "diffs": diffs}

def trace_inheritance(
    class_name: str,
    method: str = None,
    root: str = ".",
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    追踪类的继承链，可选追踪特定方法来源。

    参数:
        class_name: 类名
        method: 方法名（可选）。指定后追踪该方法在继承链中的定义位置
        root: 项目根目录

    返回:
        {
            "class_name": str,
            "mro": [str],              # 方法解析顺序
            "chain": [dict],           # 完整继承链
            "depth": int,              # 继承深度
            "method_origin": dict|None # 方法定义位置（仅在指定 method 时返回）
        }
    """
    tracker = InheritanceTracker(root)

    result = tracker.export_chain_as_dict(class_name)

    if method:
        origin = tracker.find_method_origin(class_name, method)
        result["method_origin"] = origin

    return result

def _generic_control_flow(root: Path, rel: str, source: str) -> dict[str, Anchor]:
    from parse.languages.pipeline import parse_paths

    parsed, _failures, _completed = parse_paths(root, [root / rel])
    functions = sorted(
        (item for item in parsed.values() if item.symbol_type in {"function", "method"}),
        key=lambda item: (item.line_start, item.id),
    )
    if not functions:
        return {}
    lines = source.splitlines(keepends=True)
    offsets = [0]
    for line in lines:
        offsets.append(offsets[-1] + len(line))
    result: dict[str, Anchor] = {}
    ranges: list[tuple[int, int, str]] = []
    for index, function in enumerate(functions):
        start_line = max(1, function.line_start)
        inferred_end = functions[index + 1].line_start - 1 if index + 1 < len(functions) else len(lines)
        end_line = function.line_end if function.line_end > start_line else inferred_end
        begin = offsets[min(start_line - 1, len(offsets) - 1)]
        finish = offsets[min(max(start_line, end_line), len(offsets) - 1)]
        fragment = source[begin:finish]
        for ordinal, match in enumerate(_CONTROL.finditer(fragment), 1):
            opening = begin + match.end() - 1
            closing = _brace_end(source, opening)
            if closing >= finish:
                closing = finish - 1
            line_start = _line(source, begin + match.start())
            line_end = _line(source, max(opening, closing))
            raw_kind = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", match.group("kind").lower())
            kind = "loop" if raw_kind in {"for", "foreach", "while", "do"} else "try" if raw_kind in {"try", "catch"} else "condition"
            owner = function.id
            containing = [entry for entry in ranges if entry[0] <= opening <= entry[1]]
            if containing:
                owner = min(containing, key=lambda entry: entry[1] - entry[0])[2]
            anchor_id = f"{function.id}#{kind}:{line_start}:{ordinal}"
            expr = " ".join(match.group("expr").strip().split())
            metadata = {"keyword": raw_kind, "expr": expr}
            if kind == "condition":
                metadata["cases"] = [{"scope_label": "body", "condition": expr or raw_kind}]
            elif kind == "loop":
                metadata["loop_kind"] = raw_kind
            body = source[opening + 1:closing]
            sites = []
            for seq, call in enumerate(_CALL.finditer(body)):
                target = call.group(1)
                if target.lower() in _NOISE:
                    continue
                sites.append({
                    "target": target, "raw_target": target,
                    "line": _line(source, opening + 1 + call.start()),
                    "column": 0, "seq": seq, "conds": [expr or "nocond"],
                    "resolution": "unresolved", "evidence": "control-flow-call",
                })
            digest = hashlib.sha1(f"{anchor_id}:{line_end}:{expr}".encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
            result[anchor_id] = Anchor(
                id=anchor_id, symbol=f"{kind}_block_{ordinal}", file=rel,
                line_start=line_start, line_end=line_end, hash=digest,
                language=function.language, symbol_type="virtual_block",
                is_virtual=True, virtual_kind=kind, parent_anchor=owner,
                scope_label="body", block_metadata=metadata,
                callees=[site["target"] for site in sites], call_sites=sites,
            )
            ranges.append((opening, closing, anchor_id))
    return result

def load_yaml_profile(path: str | Path, root: str | Path, anchors: dict) -> dict:
    """Execute the indexed project's own YAML loader in an isolated process."""
    source = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
    if not source.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError("YAML file not found: {}".format(source))
    repo_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
    loader_errors = []
    data = None
    loader_id = None
    loader_candidates = _loader_anchors(anchors)
    for loader in loader_candidates:
        module = _module_name(loader.file)
        function = str(loader.symbol)
        command = [
            sys.executable,
            "-m",
            "tools.CodeDendrite.api.yaml_profile_worker",
            str(Path(root).expanduser().resolve()),
            module,
            function,
            str(source),
        ]
        result = subprocess.run(
            command,
            cwd=repo_root,
            text=True,
            capture_output=True,
            check=False,
        )
        if result.returncode:
            message = result.stderr.strip() or result.stdout.strip() or "unknown loader error"
            loader_errors.append({"loader": loader.id, "error": message.splitlines()[-1]})
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(result.stdout)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            loader_errors.append({"loader": loader.id, "error": "invalid JSON result"})
            continue
        loader_id = loader.id
        break

    included_files = []
    if data is None:
        try:
            data, included_files = _safe_load_with_bases(source)
        except Exception as exc:
            raise ValueError("Project YAML loaders and safe fallback failed: {}".format(exc)) from exc
        suffix = "+_BASE_" if included_files else ""
        loader_id = "PyYAML.safe_load{} (fallback)".format(suffix)
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise ValueError("Project YAML loader result must be a mapping")

    flat = _flatten(data)
    tokens = {token for token in (_token(value) for value in flat.values()) if token}
    return {
        "path": str(source),
        "loader": loader_id,
        "loader_candidates": [anchor.id for anchor in loader_candidates],
        "loader_errors": loader_errors,
        "included_files": included_files,
        "data": data,
        "flat": flat,
        "mapping_paths": sorted(_mapping_paths(data)),
        "tokens": tokens,
    }

def get_anchor_source(symbol: str, root: str = ".", context: int = 3) -> Optional[dict]:
    """
    返回 anchor 的源码，上下各扩展 context 行。

    Returns:
        {symbol, file, line_start, line_end, actual_start, actual_end, source}
        或 None（找不到 anchor）
    """
    from index.api.anchors import get_anchor
    anchor = get_anchor(symbol, root)
    if not anchor:
        return None

    file_path = anchor.file
    if not Path(file_path).is_absolute():
        file_path = str(Path(root) / file_path)

    try:
        source = Path(file_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
    except Exception:
        return None

    line_start = anchor.line_start
    line_end = anchor.line_end
    if Path(file_path).suffix.lower() == ".py":
        line_start, line_end = _current_python_range(
            source,
            anchor.symbol,
            line_start,
            line_end,
        )

    lines = source.splitlines()
    lo = max(0, line_start - 1 - context)
    hi = min(len(lines), line_end + context)
    numbered = "\n".join(f"{lo + 1 + i:4d}  {line}" for i, line in enumerate(lines[lo:hi]))

    return {
        "symbol": anchor.symbol,
        "file": anchor.file,
        "line_start": line_start,
        "line_end": line_end,
        "actual_start": lo + 1,
        "actual_end": hi,
        "source": numbered,
    }

def find_anchor(keyword: str, root: str = ".") -> List[dict]:
    """
    按函数名模糊搜索 anchor（不需要知道文件路径）。
    匹配规则：keyword 出现在 symbol 或 file 里（大小写不敏感）。

    Returns:
        [{symbol, type, file, line, id}]，按匹配度排序（精确 > 前缀 > 包含）
    """
    from index.api.anchors import load_anchors
    anchors = load_anchors(root)
    kw = keyword.lower()

    exact, prefix, contains = [], [], []
    for a in anchors.values():
        if a.is_virtual:
            continue
        sym_lower = a.symbol.lower()
        entry = {"symbol": a.symbol, "type": a.symbol_type,
                 "file": a.file, "line": a.line_start, "id": a.id}
        if sym_lower == kw:
            exact.append(entry)
        elif sym_lower.endswith("." + kw) or sym_lower.startswith(kw):
            prefix.append(entry)
        elif kw in sym_lower or kw in a.file.lower():
            contains.append(entry)

    return exact + prefix + contains

def rebuild(target: str, include_virtual_blocks: bool = False):
    """Rebuild scan results, anchors, and relations from scratch."""
    import time as _time
    _t0 = _time.time()
    from index.api.anchors import generate_all_anchors
    from relate.api.relations import generate_relations
    from synth.api.module_tree import generate_module_summary, generate_module_tree
    from synth.smartAnalyzer.orchestrator import scan_project
    result = scan_project(root=target)
    print("Scan: {} files, {} classes, {} functions  [{:.1f}s]".format(
        result.scanned_files, result.classes_count, result.functions_count, _time.time()-_t0))

    _t1 = _time.time()
    anchors = generate_all_anchors(root=target, include_virtual_blocks=include_virtual_blocks)
    print("Anchors: created {}, skipped {}, failed {}  [{:.1f}s]".format(
        anchors["created"], anchors["skipped"], anchors["failed"], _time.time()-_t1))

    _t2 = _time.time()
    _print_relations(generate_relations(root=target))
    print("Relations done  [{:.1f}s]".format(_time.time()-_t2))

    _t3 = _time.time()
    module_tree = generate_module_tree(root=target)
    print("Module tree: {} modules  hash={}  [{:.1f}s]".format(
        len(module_tree.get("semantic_modules", [])),
        module_tree.get("call_structure_hash", "")[:12], _time.time()-_t3))

    _t4 = _time.time()
    summary = generate_module_summary(root=target)
    print("Summary: {} modules  cache={}  [{:.1f}s]".format(
        len(summary.get("modules", [])),
        "hit" if summary.get("reused_cache") else "miss", _time.time()-_t4))

    print("Wrote results to: {}/.codedendrite/".format(target))

    _t5 = _time.time()
    from parse.hash.database import HashDatabase
    from index.api.anchors import load_anchors
    _db = HashDatabase(target)
    _anchors = load_anchors(target)
    _files_with_anchors = list({a.file for a in _anchors.values()})
    _db.update(_files_with_anchors)
    _db.save()
    print("HashDB done  [{:.1f}s]  total [{:.1f}s]".format(_time.time()-_t5, _time.time()-_t0))

    # 2026-05-08: rebuild 后写入所有文件的 hash，供下次 --update 做增量检测。
    # 原来没有这一步，导致 HashDatabase 始终为空，get_stale_files() 永远返回 []。
    # 注意：不用 os.walk 重新扫（会误扫 repos/ 等大目录），直接从已生成的 anchors 提取
    # 涉及的文件路径，只有有 anchor 的文件才需要追踪变化。
    # os.walk 版本（已废弃，太慢）:
    # for _dirpath, _dirnames, _filenames in _os.walk(target): ...
    from parse.hash.database import HashDatabase
    from index.api.anchors import load_anchors
    _db = HashDatabase(target)
    _anchors = load_anchors(target)
    _files_with_anchors = list({a.file for a in _anchors.values()})
    _db.update(_files_with_anchors)
    _db.save()

    # What parser produced this index. Without it every later `update` sees a
    # missing stamp, decides the parser has changed and rebuilds again.
    _dir = os.path.join(target, ".codedendrite")
    os.makedirs(_dir, exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(_dir, "parser_version.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        json.dump({"parser": HashDatabase.PARSER_VERSION}, handle)

def update(
    target: str,
    include_virtual_blocks: bool = False,
    exclude_dirs: list | None = None,
    changed_files: list[str] | None = None,
    topology_only: bool = False,
):
    # """Incrementally refresh anchors and relations from git diff."""  # 2026-05-08: 原 docstring
    """Incrementally refresh anchors and relations based on file content hash."""
    codedendrite_dir = os.path.join(target, ".codedendrite")
    required_outputs = (
        os.path.join(codedendrite_dir, "anchors.json"),
        os.path.join(codedendrite_dir, "relations.json"),
    )
    if not all(os.path.exists(path) for path in required_outputs):
        print("Missing CodeDendrite outputs; running full rebuild.")
        rebuild(target, include_virtual_blocks=include_virtual_blocks)
        return

    # An extractor change invalidates output, not input. Every incremental path
    # asks "has this file changed?" and the answer is no — the file is untouched
    # and the fix is in the parser — so a corrected span never reaches an
    # already-indexed repository. `projectContext` in one repo sat at line
    # 440->440 for a month while a fresh parse gave 470->556. Nothing but a full
    # pass re-derives it, so a version change asks for one.
    # Only when nobody named the files. An explicit list is a caller saying
    # "just these" — that is how one page of `cdd draw` is brought up to date on
    # a click, and it has to stay a handful of files however old the index is.
    if changed_files is not None:
        _skip_parser_check = True
    else:
        _skip_parser_check = False
    from parse.hash.database import HashDatabase as _HashDatabase
    _stamp = os.path.join(codedendrite_dir, "parser_version.json")
    _want = None if _skip_parser_check else getattr(_HashDatabase, "PARSER_VERSION", None)
    _have = None
    try:
        with open(_stamp, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            _have = json.load(handle).get("parser")
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        _have = None
    if not _skip_parser_check and _have != _want:
        print("Parser version {} -> {}; running full rebuild.".format(_have, _want))
        rebuild(target, include_virtual_blocks=include_virtual_blocks)
        os.makedirs(codedendrite_dir, exist_ok=True)
        with open(_stamp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            json.dump({"parser": _want}, handle)
        return

    # 2026-05-08: 改用 HashDatabase.get_stale_files() 检测变更。
    # 原来用 git diff --name-only，只能看到未提交的变更，commit 后就看不到任何变化。
    # HashDatabase 存储每个文件上次 build 时的内容 hash，与 git 状态无关，
    # 无论 checkout / commit / rebase 都能正确检测到实际变化的文件。
    # from parse.hash.git_diff import get_changed_files
    # changed = get_changed_files(root=target)
    from parse.hash.database import HashDatabase
    from relate.api.relations import generate_relations
    from synth.api.module_tree import generate_module_summary, generate_module_tree
    from synth.smartAnalyzer.orchestrator import on_files_changed
    from pathlib import Path as _Path

    db = HashDatabase(target)
    if changed_files is None:
        changed = db.get_stale_files() + db.get_new_files(target)
    else:
        root_path = _Path(target).resolve()
        changed = []
        for value in changed_files:
            candidate = _Path(value)
            absolute = candidate.resolve() if candidate.is_absolute() else (root_path / candidate).resolve()
            try:
                relative = absolute.relative_to(root_path).as_posix()
            except ValueError as exc:
                raise SystemExit("Changed file escapes project root: {}".format(value)) from exc
            if relative not in changed:
                changed.append(relative)
    if exclude_dirs:
        _excl = set(exclude_dirs)
        changed = [f for f in changed if not any(part in _excl for part in _Path(f).parts)]
    if not changed:
        print("No changed files detected; skipping anchor refresh.")
    else:
        print("Changed files: {}".format(len(changed)))
        result = on_files_changed(
            changed_files=changed,
            root=target,
            include_virtual_blocks=include_virtual_blocks,
        )
        print("Anchor update: {}".format(result.get("anchors.updated", result)))

    _print_relations(generate_relations(root=target))
    if not topology_only:
        module_tree = generate_module_tree(root=target)
        print(
            "Module tree: {} modules  hash={}".format(
                len(module_tree.get("semantic_modules", [])),
                module_tree.get("call_structure_hash", "")[:12],
            )
        )
        summary = generate_module_summary(root=target)
        print(
            "Summary: {} modules  cache={}".format(
                len(summary.get("modules", [])),
                "hit" if summary.get("reused_cache") else "miss",
            )
        )

    from index.api.anchors import load_anchors
    _anchors = load_anchors(target)
    _files_with_anchors = list({a.file for a in _anchors.values()} | set(changed))
    refreshed = db.update(_files_with_anchors)
    print("HashDB refreshed: {} files".format(refreshed))
    print("Wrote results to: {}/.codedendrite/".format(target))

def external_deps(target: str, show_files: bool = False) -> int:
    """Report the packages that must be installed before the project imports."""
    _ensure_path()
    import json
    from pathlib import Path

    from parse.codeGenome.deps import external_dependencies, format_report

    database_path = Path(target).expanduser().resolve() / ".code_genome_db.json"
    if not database_path.is_file():
        print(f"missing {database_path} — run the CLI once without --deps to build it")
        return 1

    with open(database_path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        database = json.load(handle)
    print(format_report(external_dependencies(database, target), show_files=show_files))
    return 0

def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="CodeDendrite unified CLI")
    parser.add_argument("target", help="Project root directory")
    parser.add_argument("--update", action="store_true", help="Incrementally refresh anchors and relations")
    parser.add_argument("--changed-files", nargs="*", default=None, help="Refresh only these project-relative files")
    parser.add_argument("--topology-only", action="store_true", help="Skip module tree and summary refresh")
    parser.add_argument("--debug-loop", action="store_true", help="Run the unified bug-location workflow")
    parser.add_argument("--modules", action="store_true", help="Query semantic modules")
    parser.add_argument("--module-graph", action="store_true", help="Render standard semantic module tree graph")
    parser.add_argument("--deps", action="store_true", help="List external packages the project imports")
    parser.add_argument("--deps-files", action="store_true", help="With --deps, show which files import each package")
    parser.add_argument("--anchor-outline", action="store_true", help="Write a folder/file/symbol outline from anchors.json")
    parser.add_argument("--outline-output", help="Output path for --anchor-outline")
    parser.add_argument("--virtual-blocks", action="store_true", help="Include debug-only control-flow virtual block anchors")
    parser.add_argument("--no-virtual-blocks", action="store_true", help="Deprecated compatibility flag; virtual blocks are off by default")
    parser.add_argument("--no-isolated", action="store_true", help="Hide isolated modules in --module-graph")
    parser.add_argument("--query", help="Free-text module query")
    parser.add_argument("--symbol", help="Find the module that owns this symbol")
    parser.add_argument("--module-id", help="Show one module by id or exact name")
    parser.add_argument("--error", dest="error_msg", help="Error message or failure description")
    parser.add_argument("--file", dest="file_path", help="File related to the failure, e.g. backend/main.py")
    parser.add_argument("--entry-symbol", help="Entry function or method symbol")
    parser.add_argument("--target-symbol", help="Known target function or method symbol")
    parser.add_argument("--conditions", help="Python dict literal for route conditions")
    parser.add_argument("--edited-files", nargs="*", default=None, help="Edited files for verification coverage")
    parser.add_argument("--edited-symbols", nargs="*", default=None, help="Edited symbols for verification coverage")
    parser.add_argument("--no-refresh", action="store_true", help="Skip refresh before debug loop queries")
    parser.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=5, help="Number of suspect functions to keep")
    parser.add_argument("--module-tree-v2", action="store_true", help="Generate Module Tree V2 (candidates + tree + completeness + html)")
    parser.add_argument("--capability-candidates", action="store_true", help="Generate capability_candidates.json only")
    parser.add_argument("--module-tree-v2-html", action="store_true", help="Render module_tree_v2.html only")
    parser.add_argument("--module-tree-v2-check", action="store_true", help="Show completeness / validation summary")
    parser.add_argument("--path-policy-check", help="Check path role for a given path")
    parser.add_argument("--task-context", help="Generate Task Context Packet for a given anchor/symbol/keyword")
    parser.add_argument("--task-context-compact", help="Print compact text Task Context Packet (for small models)")
    parser.add_argument("--model-profile", choices=["small", "large"], default="small", help="Task context prompt profile")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    target = os.path.abspath(args.target)

    if args.module_tree_v2:
        _cmd_module_tree_v2(target)
        return 0

    if args.capability_candidates:
        _cmd_capability_candidates(target)
        return 0

    if args.module_tree_v2_html:
        _cmd_module_tree_v2_html(target)
        return 0

    if args.module_tree_v2_check:
        _cmd_module_tree_v2_check(target)
        return 0

    if args.path_policy_check:
        _cmd_path_policy_check(target, args.path_policy_check)
        return 0

    if args.task_context:
        _cmd_task_context(target, args.task_context, error_text=args.error_msg, model_profile=args.model_profile)
        return 0

    if args.task_context_compact:
        _cmd_task_context_compact(target, args.task_context_compact, error_text=args.error_msg, model_profile=args.model_profile)
        return 0

    if args.debug_loop:
        if not args.error_msg or not args.file_path:
            parser.error("--debug-loop requires --error and --file")
        debug_loop(
            target=target,
            error_msg=args.error_msg,
            file_path=args.file_path,
            entry_symbol=args.entry_symbol,
            target_symbol=args.target_symbol,
            conditions=_parse_conditions(args.conditions),
            edited_files=args.edited_files,
            edited_symbols=args.edited_symbols,
            refresh=not args.no_refresh,
            limit=args.limit,
        )
        return 0

    if args.modules:
        module_query(
            target=target,
            query=args.query,
            symbol=args.symbol,
            module_id=args.module_id,
            limit=args.limit,
        )
        return 0

    if args.module_graph:
        module_graph(
            target=target,
            include_isolated=not args.no_isolated,
        )
        return 0

    if args.deps:
        return external_deps(target, show_files=args.deps_files)

    if args.anchor_outline:
        anchor_outline(target, output=args.outline_output)
        return 0

    include_virtual_blocks = bool(args.virtual_blocks and not args.no_virtual_blocks)

    if args.update:
        update(
            target,
            include_virtual_blocks=include_virtual_blocks,
            changed_files=args.changed_files,
            topology_only=args.topology_only,
        )
        return 0

    rebuild(target, include_virtual_blocks=include_virtual_blocks)
    return 0

def _cmd_module_tree_v2_check(target: str):
    import json
    from pathlib import Path

    comp_path = Path(target) / ".codedendrite" / "module_tree_v2_completeness.json"
    tree_path = Path(target) / ".codedendrite" / "module_tree_v2.json"

    if not tree_path.exists():
        print("module_tree_v2.json 不存在，先运行 --module-tree-v2")
        return

    with open(tree_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        tree = json.load(f)

    summary = tree.get("summary", {})
    comp = tree.get("completeness", {})

    print("=== Module Tree V2 检查 ===")
    print("模块数: {}".format(summary.get("total_modules", 0)))
    print("状态: {}".format(summary.get("by_status", {})))
    print("信心: {}".format(summary.get("by_confidence", {})))

    ac = comp.get("area_coverage", {})
    print("\n区域覆盖: {}/{}".format(ac.get("covered", 0), ac.get("total_areas", 0)))
    if ac.get("uncovered"):
        print("  未覆盖: {}".format(", ".join(ac["uncovered"])))

    warnings = comp.get("fake_module_warnings", [])
    if warnings:
        print("\n假模块警告:")
        for w in warnings:
            print("  - {} ({})".format(w.get("name"), w.get("reason")))

    low_conf = comp.get("low_confidence_modules", [])
    if low_conf:
        print("\n低信心模块:")
        for lc in low_conf:
            print("  - {} ({})".format(lc.get("name"), lc.get("confidence")))

    missing = comp.get("missing_evidence", [])
    if missing:
        print("\n证据不足:")
        for me in missing:
            print("  - {} (缺 {})".format(me.get("name"), ", ".join(me.get("missing", []))))

    if not warnings and not low_conf and not missing:
        print("\n所有检查通过!")

def locate_bug(
    error_msg: str,
    file_path: str,
    root: str,
    entry_symbol: Optional[str] = None,
    target_symbol: Optional[str] = None,
    conditions: Optional[dict] = None,
    refresh: bool = True,
    limit: int = 5,
) -> dict:
    """
    函数级问题定位器。

    目标：
        从错误信息 / 文件路径 / 可选入口函数出发，
        给出一个按可疑度排序的函数节点列表。
    """
    if refresh:
        _refresh_navigation(root)

    conditions = conditions or {}
    anchors = load_anchors(root)

    target_anchor = _resolve_target_anchor(
        target_symbol=target_symbol,
        error_msg=error_msg,
        file_path=file_path,
        root=root,
        anchors=anchors,
    )
    target_id = (
        f"{target_anchor.file}::{target_anchor.symbol}"
        if target_anchor else None
    )
    related_modules = _locate_relevant_modules(
        root=root,
        file_path=file_path,
        error_msg=error_msg,
        entry_symbol=entry_symbol,
        target_anchor=target_anchor,
        conditions=conditions,
        limit=max(limit, 3),
    )

    relation_graph = {}
    relation_edges = []
    if target_id:
        try:
            from relate.api.relations import expand_node
            relation_graph = expand_node(target_id, root=root, radius=1)
            relation_edges = relation_graph.get("edges", [])
        except Exception:
            relation_graph = {}
            relation_edges = []

    traced_nodes = []
    trace_summary = None
    if entry_symbol and target_anchor:
        entry_anchor = get_anchor(entry_symbol, root=root)
        traced_nodes, trace_summary = _trace_bug_path(
            root=root,
            entry_anchor=entry_anchor,
            target_anchor=target_anchor,
            anchors=anchors,
            conditions=conditions,
        )

    suspects = _rank_bug_suspects(
        anchors=anchors,
        target_anchor=target_anchor,
        relation_edges=relation_edges,
        traced_nodes=traced_nodes,
        file_path=file_path,
        error_msg=error_msg,
        limit=limit,
    )
    related_modules = _align_modules_with_suspects(
        related_modules=related_modules,
        suspects=suspects,
        root=root,
    )

    return {
        "error": error_msg,
        "file": file_path,
        "entry_symbol": entry_symbol,
        "target_symbol": target_anchor.symbol if target_anchor else target_symbol,
        "target_id": target_id,
        "related_modules": related_modules,
        "top_module": related_modules[0] if related_modules else None,
        "trace_summary": trace_summary,
        "trace_nodes": traced_nodes,
        "relation_graph": relation_graph,
        "suspects": suspects,
    }

def diagnose_bug(
    error_msg: str,
    file_path: str,
    root: str,
    entry_symbol: Optional[str] = None,
    target_symbol: Optional[str] = None,
    conditions: Optional[dict] = None,
    refresh: bool = True,
    limit: int = 5,
) -> dict:
    """
    在 locate_bug() 之上补充函数级诊断信息，形成更接近修复闭环的输出。
    """
    diagnosis = locate_bug(
        error_msg=error_msg,
        file_path=file_path,
        root=root,
        entry_symbol=entry_symbol,
        target_symbol=target_symbol,
        conditions=conditions,
        refresh=refresh,
        limit=limit,
    )

    suspects = diagnosis.get("suspects", [])
    if not suspects:
        diagnosis.update({
            "top_suspect": None,
            "suspect_reasons": [],
            "relevant_variables": [],
            "relevant_branches": [],
            "minimal_verification_step": None,
            "suggested_edit_scope": None,
        })
        return diagnosis

    conditions = conditions or {}
    anchors = load_anchors(root)
    top_suspect = suspects[0]
    top_anchor = _get_anchor_from_suspect(top_suspect, anchors)

    flow = None
    if top_anchor:
        try:
            from relate.dataFlow.analyzer import analyze_function_flow
            flow = analyze_function_flow(str(Path(root) / top_anchor.file), top_anchor.symbol)
        except Exception:
            flow = None

    relevant_branches = _extract_relevant_branches(
        diagnosis=diagnosis,
        top_anchor=top_anchor,
        conditions=conditions,
    )
    relevant_variables = _extract_relevant_variables(
        top_suspect=top_suspect,
        flow=flow,
        conditions=conditions,
        branches=relevant_branches,
    )
    minimal_verification_step = _build_minimal_verification_step(
        entry_symbol=entry_symbol,
        top_suspect=top_suspect,
        branches=relevant_branches,
        conditions=conditions,
        trace_summary=diagnosis.get("trace_summary"),
    )
    suggested_edit_scope = _build_edit_scope(
        top_suspect=top_suspect,
        diagnosis=diagnosis,
        branches=relevant_branches,
    )

    diagnosis.update({
        "top_suspect": top_suspect,
        "suspect_reasons": top_suspect.get("reasons", []),
        "relevant_variables": relevant_variables,
        "relevant_branches": relevant_branches,
        "minimal_verification_step": minimal_verification_step,
        "suggested_edit_scope": suggested_edit_scope,
    })
    return diagnosis

def plan_fix(
    error_msg: str,
    file_path: str,
    root: str,
    entry_symbol: Optional[str] = None,
    target_symbol: Optional[str] = None,
    conditions: Optional[dict] = None,
    refresh: bool = True,
    limit: int = 5,
) -> dict:
    """
    在 diagnose_bug() 之上生成更偏执行层的修复计划。
    """
    diagnosis = diagnose_bug(
        error_msg=error_msg,
        file_path=file_path,
        root=root,
        entry_symbol=entry_symbol,
        target_symbol=target_symbol,
        conditions=conditions,
        refresh=refresh,
        limit=limit,
    )

    top_suspect = diagnosis.get("top_suspect")
    if not top_suspect:
        diagnosis.update({
            "fix_hypothesis": None,
            "proposed_steps": [],
            "verification_steps": [],
            "edit_targets": [],
            "risk_notes": [],
        })
        return diagnosis

    relevant_branches = diagnosis.get("relevant_branches", [])
    relevant_variables = diagnosis.get("relevant_variables", [])
    suggested_scope = diagnosis.get("suggested_edit_scope") or {}
    top_branch = next((b for b in relevant_branches if b.get("matches_conditions")), None)

    fix_hypothesis = _build_fix_hypothesis(
        top_suspect=top_suspect,
        top_branch=top_branch,
        relevant_variables=relevant_variables,
    )
    proposed_steps = _build_proposed_steps(
        top_suspect=top_suspect,
        top_branch=top_branch,
        diagnosis=diagnosis,
    )
    verification_steps = _build_verification_steps(
        diagnosis=diagnosis,
        top_branch=top_branch,
    )
    edit_targets = _build_edit_targets(
        top_suspect=top_suspect,
        suggested_scope=suggested_scope,
    )
    risk_notes = _build_risk_notes(
        diagnosis=diagnosis,
        top_branch=top_branch,
    )

    diagnosis.update({
        "fix_hypothesis": fix_hypothesis,
        "proposed_steps": proposed_steps,
        "verification_steps": verification_steps,
        "edit_targets": edit_targets,
        "risk_notes": risk_notes,
    })
    return diagnosis
